description: US EPA pesticide product lookup by EPA registration number (e.g. 66551-1). Returns today: product name and registration status, signal word, restricted-use flag, formulation, active ingredients, and label PDF file names with acceptance dates. The application rate, REI and PPE numbers are printed inside those PDFs; this release returns them as UNKNOWN until label-text extraction ships (Phase 2). $0.05 per call in USDC.
name: get_label_rate
